content.title: Atlético Madrid vs Barcelona LIVE: lineups and LaLiga match updates
content.text: Barcelona beat Atlético Madrid 2-1 and are now seven points behind Real Madrid in the La Liga title race.88' Robert Lewandowski chests the ball in after a reboundThe goalkeeper has already made three crucial saves against Barcelona.In a controversial play reviewed by VAR, Gerard Martin was initially sent off, but the referee later reversed the decision.After a VAR review, Nico González is shown a red card for a foul on Yamal, and that's how the first half ends42' Marcus Rashford cuts inside and finishes after a combination with Dani Olmo39' Long pass to Simeone, who gets behind Cancelo and finishes for 1-0The Barcelona number 10 combined with Fermín, but his shot struck the post.The Frenchman beat two defenders, but his shot went straight into Joan García's hands.Atlético de Madrid faces Barcelona without Marcos Llorente.Atlético Madrid and Barcelona face off in the standout match of LaLiga Matchday 30.Diego Simeone’s side begin a run of three consecutive matches against Hansi Flick’s Barcelona.Barcelona lead LaLiga with 73 points after beating Rayo Vallecano and thrashing Newcastle in the Champions League, while also benefiting from Real Madrid’s loss to Mallorca.Atlético, meanwhile, dropped to fourth after losing the derby but bounced back by eliminating Tottenham and now prepare for another clash with Barcelona in Europe. Confirmed lineups Atlético de Madrid: Musso, Molina, Le Normand, Lenglet, Giuliano, Koke, Obed Vargas, Baena, Nico, Almada, Griezmann Barcelona: Joan García, Cancelo, Araújo, Cubarsí, Gerard Martín, Eric, Pedri, Lamine Yamal, Fermín, Olmo, Rashford
